messages:
dana (events): Quick preflight for Thurs 3pm micro-webinar — keeping it 'lite' but want a tight reg UX + reliable recording handoff. Can we run a short checklist? cc @marie @jordan @sam

marie (marketing): Yes. Core asks: 1) single-column reg page, 2) one clear CTA (Watch Live), 3) privacy consent checkbox + replay opt-in, 4) short thank-you with calendar add. I can update copy.

jordan (ops): Zoom config: alt host jordan@redwood.ai; cloud recording -> S3; disable waiting room to reduce friction; co-hosts enabled for manual stop/export.

sam (growth): Lead routing: tag registrants source=paid_ig program=micro-webinar-2026. Attendees -> push to CRM immediately + trigger 48h replay drip. Non-attendees -> 7-day nurture only if opted into replay.

zoombot: Meeting created: https://zoom.us/j/99999999999 | Passcode: 123456 | Cloud recording enabled

jordan (ops): Applying recording settings:
```
Record to: Cloud
Alternative host: jordan@redwood.ai
Auto-transcript: ON
Save chat: ON
Post-process: upload to s3://redwood-webinars-prod
Filename convention: rw-micro-2026-05-14-<meeting-id>-<utc>
```
I'll add a lambda to archive after 90 days per legal retention.

marie (marketing): Reg page copy checklist (pushing to CMS): Headline: "Ship faster with inference — 30-min micro-demo"; Subheadline: benefit + one-liner; CTA: "Reserve my spot — Free"; Form: email, company, role (optional); Checkbox: consent + replay opt-in; Calendar add + confirmation ETA. Preview: https://redwood.com/events/micro-demo-2026-preview

dana (events): Ownership confirmed: marie=reg page+copy+design coord; jordan=Zoom config+S3+recordings pipeline; sam=CRM zaps+nurture. Rehearsal tomorrow 2pm. Host to record local backup as fallback. :thumbsup:

jordan (ops): S3 lambda test passed. Sample uploaded: s3://redwood-webinars-prod/rw-micro-2026-05-14-99999999999-1719812345.mp4

sam (growth): Zap/Segment tests passed. Will ensure HubSpot dedupe on email and schedule the 48h replay email + segment rules.

marie (marketing): Adding a bright line on confirmation page: "Replay will be sent to attendees" to set expectations.

jordan (ops): Final: set transcript retention 365 days, enable PII redaction during post-process, noted in the runbook.

dana (events): Closing thread — will post 1h reminder and final checklist in #release-war-room.
